strings: r_c0 gently speaks to m_c, talking at length with {PRONOUN/m_c/object} about the herbs in the medicine den, trying to assure {PRONOUN/m_c/object} that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} safe.
m_c is wandering around camp, somehow convinced that the world will be ending soon and is rather listless.
m_c refuses to eat the prey on the fresh-kill pile, going out each day to catch even fresher prey for {PRONOUN/m_c/self} instead.
While the rest of the Clan settles down for the night, m_c is getting up every few hours to check and make sure that things are still safe and fine.
m_c keeps waking up {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} denmates to get them to check just one more time if they are really sure the camp is secure.

{PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/are/is} not paranoid, it's just the proper level of caution, m_c insists as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/check/checks} for the third time that afternoon that the nursery is secure.
